text: The purpose of this staff report is to report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a Clothing Drop Box Location permit at 1540 Bloor Street West.
City Council on October 27, 28 and 30, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the application for the proposed Clothing Drop Box Location permit at 1540 Bloor Street West.
